reference.code: pub fn parse_quoted_list(s:&str)->Option<Vec<String>>{if s.is_empty(){return Some(vec![])}let b=s.as_bytes();let mut i=0;let mut out=vec![];loop{if b.get(i)!=Some(&b'"'){return None}i+=1;let mut v=String::new();let mut closed=false;while i<b.len(){if b[i]==b'"'{if b.get(i+1)==Some(&b'"'){v.push('"');i+=2}else{i+=1;closed=true;break}}else{v.push(b[i]as char);i+=1}}if !closed{return None}out.push(v);if i==b.len(){return Some(out)}if b.get(i)!=Some(&b',')||i+1==b.len(){return None}i+=1}}
